description: Ensure approved option images survive into the handoff package so ecosystem-manager executors see them as visual targets. When an idea backlog item is processed and handoff/manifest.json is generated, resolve any workshop option image_url values (including local file paths) into persistent references stored alongside the handoff. Executor agents then have both the textual plan and the visual target. Automated test: process an idea with image-bearing decisions, verify manifest.json has the image references and that the files exist in the handoff directory.
name: decision-image-handoff-propagation
title: Propagate decision-option images through ecosystem-manager handoff
